title: POLAR Posture Recognition: Audited DINOv2 and ConvNeXt Benchmarks
description: Source-overlap-audited four-class POLAR benchmark: a locked ensemble reaches 93.988333% macro-F1 and 94.562932% accuracy on 3,329 held-out images. Includes original training code, tests, aggregate evidence, uncertainty, reports, figures, the V-COCO person-level transfer follow-up and matched DINOv2/DINOv3/SigLIP2 development screens. These custom tasks are not standard leaderboard comparisons. Independent project version 1.0.0 preserves the original study versions and scores. Source media and checkpoints are not redistributed. This metadata does not itself indicate a Zenodo deposit or DOI.
